StudySession.title: StudySession
StudySession.description: A saved question-and-answer, solved question paper, video breakdown, or voice note session.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

title.description: Short summary title for the question or paper.

prompt.description: User question or instruction submitted to Gemini.

attachmentName.description: Display filename of attached document, image, or video.

attachmentMimeType.description: MIME type of the attached file if present.

modelUsed.description: Gemini model name used for the response.

isBookmarked.description: Whether the user bookmarked this answer for quick review.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A message inside the user's persistent multi-turn AI tutor chat thread.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

attachmentLabel.description: Optional label of attached paper or image.

modelUsed.description: Gemini model used to generate the response.

isDeepThinking.description: Whether high thinking mode was active.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/studySessions/{sessionId.description: User-owned saved Q&A items and solved question papers.

/users/{userId}/chatMessages/{messageId}.description: User-owned multi-turn AI tutor conversation messages.
